bullets: · Contributed to Oracle ACFS (cluster filesystem) validation infrastructure, working on backend test frameworks for storage and volume management systems. · Designed and implemented automated workflows to validate volume, snapshot, clone, and quarantine operations, ensuring correctness under concurrent and failure scenarios. · Analyzed large-scale test failures by parsing logs, kernel outputs, and .dif artifacts, performing detailed root cause analysis across filesystem and system layers in production-like environments. · Improved observability by introducing structured logging (Tlog) and enhancing test execution visibility, significantly reducing debugging time for complex infra-level failures across multiple test scenarios. · Enhanced reliability of test execution pipelines by refining command orchestration and error-handling logic in Perl-based backend frameworks, improving overall execution stability and consistency.

· Designed and implemented a high-throughput Go-based microservice for Aadhaar reactivation using gRPC and HTTP, handling large-scale concurrent requests with optimized latency and reliability. · Built a distributed enrolment tracking system using Go and MySQL, enabling real-time status updates and improving system observability through OpenTelemetry (OTEL) instrumentation. · Improved system reliability and debugging by integrating centralized logging, metrics, and tracing, reducing issue resolution time during production incidents. · Developed and deployed services using CI/CD pipelines (ArgoCD), ensuring automated rollouts and environment consistency across deployments. · Implemented secure authentication and communication using JWT, gRPC, and encryption techniques, ensuring safe data exchange in high-volume identity systems. · Reduced manual processing overhead by 40% by integrating child enrolment workflows (BRN, DigiLocker, Passport) into existing backend systems. · Built a React-based authentication interface integrating biometric verification flows, improving system usability.

· Developed an automated routing system using C++ and JavaScript, optimizing execution plans and reducing manual intervention by 30%. · Implemented real-time signal clearance logic based on movement constraints, improving system efficiency and decision accuracy.

· Improved frontend performance and responsiveness using React.js and Node.js, enhancing user engagement. · Identified and resolved cross-device compatibility issues, improving overall platform stability.
